Python Imports


Code
import pandas as pd
import duckdb
from mplsoccer import Sbopen
import os

# Suppressing StatsBomb credentials warning (free open data)
os.environ["SB_USERNAME"] = ""
os.environ["SB_PASSWORD"] = ""

parser = Sbopen()
print("Sbopen parser ready ✅")
print(f"pandas    : {pd.__version__}")
print(f"duckdb    : {duckdb.__version__}")

title: Exploring Soccer Data for Analysis
text:
Loading + Cleaning the data

Checking Names
In my UMass Amherst Sports Analytics class, for analyzing Argentina’s matches, I had to adjust Messi’s name as full names were jumbling up the plots e.g. Lionel Andrés Messi Cuccittini. Here I will check all the 64 matches for long names


Code
long_names = set()

for _, row in matches.iterrows():
    df_event, _, _, _ = parser.event(row["match_id"])
    
    for col in ["player_name", "pass_recipient_name"]:
        names = df_event[col].dropna()
        names = names[names.str.split().str.len() > 3].unique()
        long_names.update(names)

print(f"Total long names found: {len(long_names)}")
print("\nFull list:")
for name in sorted(long_names):
    print(f"  {name}")

# Helper functions
def safe_select(df, columns):
    return df[[col for col in columns if col in df.columns]]

def clean_names(df):
    for col in ["player_name", "pass_recipient_name"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].replace(name_map)
    return df

def process_shots(df):
    shots = df[df["type_name"] == "Shot"].copy()
    shots["goal"] = (shots["outcome_name"] == "Goal").astype(int)
    return safe_select(shots, [
        "match_id", "player_name", "team_name",
        "minute", "second", "period",
        "x", "y", "end_x", "end_y", "end_z",
        "shot_statsbomb_xg", "outcome_name",
        "technique_name", "body_part_name",
        "shot_first_time", "shot_one_on_one",
        "shot_open_goal", "under_pressure", "goal"
    ])

def process_passes(df):
    passes = df[df["type_name"] == "Pass"].copy()
    passes["incomplete"] = passes["outcome_name"].isin(
        ["Incomplete", "Pass Offside", "Out"]
    ).astype(int)
    return safe_select(passes, [
        "match_id", "player_name", "pass_recipient_name",
        "team_name", "possession_team_name",
        "minute", "second", "period",
        "x", "y", "end_x", "end_y",
        "pass_length", "pass_angle",
        "pass_height_name", "pass_cross",
        "pass_switch", "pass_goal_assist",
        "pass_shot_assist", "outcome_name",
        "under_pressure", "incomplete"
    ])

# Load all matches
all_shots  = []
all_passes = []

for _, row in matches.iterrows():
    df_event, _, _, _ = parser.event(row["match_id"])
    df_event = clean_names(df_event)
    all_shots.append(process_shots(df_event))
    all_passes.append(process_passes(df_event))
    print(f"✅ {row['home_team_name']} vs {row['away_team_name']}")

shots_df  = pd.concat(all_shots,  ignore_index=True)
passes_df = pd.concat(all_passes, ignore_index=True)

# Save to DuckDB 
con = duckdb.connect("wc2022.duckdb")
con.execute("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS matches")
con.execute("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS shots")
con.execute("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS passes")
con.execute("CREATE TABLE matches AS SELECT * FROM matches")
con.execute("CREATE TABLE shots  AS SELECT * FROM shots_df")
con.execute("CREATE TABLE passes AS SELECT * FROM passes_df")
con.close()

print(f"\n🦆 DuckDB saved: wc2022.duckdb")
print(f"   matches : {len(matches):,} rows")
print(f"   shots   : {len(shots_df):,} rows")
print(f"   passes  : {len(passes_df):,} rows")
